pages.text: $(bold)One trigger. One socketed spell.$()$(br2)First engrave the $(thing)ring itself$() with a Ring Trigger scroll. Then use the Socketing Bench to add an ordinary engraved gem. The trigger decides $(italic)when$() the ring fires; the gem decides $(italic)what$() it casts. Its cooldown comes from the socketed spell.

pages.title: Ring Triggers
pages.text: $(bold)On Hit$(): after taking damage$(br)$(bold)On Attack$(): when you attack$(br)$(bold)On Falling$(): after a dangerous fall$(br)$(bold)On Kill$(): when you slay a mob$(br)$(bold)HP Threshold$(): when health drops bellow 3 and a half hearts$(br)$(bold)In Radius$() — while a monster is nearby$(br2)Trigger engravings cannot take modifiers; put modifiers on the socketed gem instead.
